Hi Liam — thanks for the options and the context.

Quick note up front: the week you picked (Mar 8–12) is the US DST changeover week. The US moves clocks forward on Sun Mar 8; Europe doesn't move until later in March. That means a slot expressed in ET vs CET will shift by one hour relative to UTC between Mar 7 and Mar 29. To avoid invite confusion for cross-regional attendees, our approach is to either:

1) Anchor the meeting in UTC and send timezone-aware invites (preferred), or
2) Run two sequential regional handoffs (EMEA lead + APAC follow-up), or
3) Record a single session and run a short live Q&A per region.

Can you confirm whether you prefer a single UTC-anchored slot (I can propose two UTC times that map to your local windows) or the handoff/recording flow? If UTC is OK, please tell us which of the three regional time windows is highest priority so we can pick a UTC time that minimally impacts the others.

I'll loop Marcus for SLA/throughput highlights and Soojin for the security/compliance brief.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

On Sat, Mar 7, 2026 at 14:35 -05:00, marcus_lin wrote:
> Quick tech note for the group: once the US jumps to DST on Sun Mar 8 the ET->UTC offset becomes -4 (previously -5). CET stays at +1 until late March, so a 10:00 ET meeting on Mon becomes 14:00 UTC on Mon after the change, whereas CET mapping is unchanged — so what used to be a clean overlap will be off by an hour for the next three weeks.

Hi all — following Tessa's suggestion, my recommendation is:

- Anchor the demo in UTC. Proposed slots (45 min): 13:00 UTC or 17:00 UTC on Tue Mar 9 or Wed Mar 10.
  - 13:00 UTC maps to Mon/Tue windows as: 08:00 ET (US morning), 14:00 CET (EU afternoon), 22:00 JST (late evening) — better for US/EU combo.
  - 17:00 UTC maps to 12:00 ET, 18:00 CET, 02:00 JST — better for EU-first, APAC follow-up.

- Fallback plan if a single cross-region slot won't work: run a primary demo anchored to UTC for US+EU, record it, then schedule a 30-minute APAC office-hours the following day with regional infra folks for hands-on configs.

I'll attach a quick timezone matrix (acme-timezone-matrix.xlsx) and a 45-minute agenda (acme-pilot-agenda-v2.pdf). Tessa, if you're OK with 13:00 UTC Tue Mar 9 as primary, I'll draft the invite (ICS) and include the recording/follow-up plan.

—Marcus
